title: Tagging a teammate with @ in a Plan or to-do comment notifies them

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-24: @mentions exist only in feed posts (post_mentions, fanOutMentions in app/(main)/feed/actions.ts). A host who writes '@sam can you take the flyers' on a Plan to-do notifies nobody unless Sam is the assignee. Fix: a public.mentions table (source_type, source_id, target_type, target_id, created_by) written on save, never parsed on read; mention nodes store ids, not names; the server re-checks the person can see the Plan before notifying; an 'item.mention' notification type. Owner ruling 2026-11-24: the hub is built inside Spaces and the Frequency team runs from its own Space.

DONE 2026-11-24: a public.mentions table (20270346300000, which also adds the LIVE-2526 Inbox columns) stores each @ tag by id. Plan and to-do comments offer @ for the people who work the Plan (MentionTextarea), the server keeps only those people (planMentionTargets), writes the rows (recordCommentMentions) and sends an item.mention notice (in-app and push, mentions category); the bell opens the Plan through the Spaces hub. Tags render as chips (MessageText) and read as @Name on a lock screen.
